```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap
from matplotlib.patches import Polygon
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('No es troba el projecte')
    root=root.parent
data=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/practiques-mapes.json').read_text())
ortho=plt.imread(root/'context/inputs/ortofoto-pineda-2025.png')
metadata=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/ortofoto-pineda-2025.json').read_text())
assert metadata['bbox']==[347200,4550750,348050,4551420]
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':13,'svg.fonttype':'none'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(9.4,4.9),layout='constrained')
extent=np.array(data['walking_extent'])/1000
geometry=data['solar'];polys=geometry['coordinates'] if geometry['type']=='MultiPolygon' else [geometry['coordinates']]
for ax,scenario,title in zip(axes,['obert','penalitzat'],['A · Cost uniforme','B · Solar amb cost 20']):
    stats=data['controls']['walking'][scenario]
    ax.imshow(ortho,origin='upper',extent=extent,zorder=0)
    for polygon in polys:
        ax.add_patch(Polygon(np.array(polygon[0])/1000,facecolor='#f5c159' if scenario=='penalitzat' else 'none',
                            edgecolor='#ffe08a',lw=1.8,alpha=.3 if scenario=='penalitzat' else 1,zorder=1))
    xy=np.array(data['walking_paths'][scenario])/1000
    ax.plot(xy[:,0],xy[:,1],color='#006699',lw=2.7,zorder=3,
            path_effects=[pe.Stroke(linewidth=5,foreground='white'),pe.Normal()])
    for label,point in [('O',data['walking_start']),('D',data['walking_end'])]:
        x,y=np.array(point)/1000;ax.plot(x,y,'o',color='#b33442',ms=6,zorder=4)
        ax.text(x,y+.045,label,ha='center',color='#8d2632',weight='bold',zorder=5,
                bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none','alpha':.95,'pad':1})
    ax.set(title=title+'\n'+f"{stats['length_m']:.1f} m".replace('.',','),
           xlabel='Est UTM (km)',ylabel='Nord UTM (km)',aspect='equal')
    ax.ticklabel_format(useOffset=False,style='plain');ax.tick_params(labelsize=13)
    ax.text(.04,.04,'Graella de 5 m',transform=ax.transAxes,
            bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none','alpha':.95})
out=root/'assets/img/generated/accessibilitat-territorial.svg'
fig.savefig(out,facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
